_comment: Copy this to projects.json and fill in your own values; projects.json is gitignored and never committed. 'roadmap_ids' are the Program ID values carried by initiatives in the Tactical Cycle daily snapshot — list more than one where an ID has drifted historically, and the skill folds them into a single project. 'doc' is the Google Doc ID of that project's Live Update document; null means report-only, with no document to publish to. 'tab_ok' records whether the target tab already exists: the Docs API cannot create a tab, so the skill stops and asks rather than writing into the wrong one.
excluded_teams: <a squad configured in Cadence but not reported on>

projects.name: <project, named as its Live Update document names it>
<a project whose document lacks the target tab>
projects.tab_note: No 'AI Live Update' tab — needs creating by hand before this project can be published.

projects.name: <a programme with no Live Update document>
